entries.title: Jeremiah 21:1
segments: Zedekiah; the last king of Judah.  This was during the final siege of the city by Nebuchadnezzar, near the close of his reign.

entries.title: Jeremiah 21:2
segments: God's wondrous works in days past afford no ground of encouragement to wicked and corrupt rulers in he visible church, since the effect of his interposition in her behalf must be not their salvation, but their destruction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 21:3
segments: God's servants must return to those who consult them, of whatever rank or station, not such answers as will be pleasing to them, but such as are in accordance with truth.  To those who persist in sin there can be no message of peace.

entries.title: Jeremiah 21:8
segments:
vv 8-10. 
 
The only path of safety for nations or individuals lies in submission to God's declared will, however humbling it may be to their pride.

entries.title: Jeremiah 21:12
segments:
In the morning; every morning; that is, promptly and habitually. The morning was the regular time for the administration of justice. 
 
For rulers and people there is but one law--righteousness and prosperity, or wickedness and ruin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 21:13
segments: O inhabitant of the valley--rock of the plain; the same as "my mountain in the field,"

. 
 
  Shall come down; from the higher hills in the vicinity, where the armies of the enemy were encamped.
